local function safe(fn, ...)
    local ok, res = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then return res end
end

local B64 = {
    logo       = "",
    avatar     = "",
    ic_game    = "",
    ic_visuals = "",
    ic_world   = "",
    ic_player  = "",
    ic_models  = "",
    ic_anim    = "",
    ic_emotes  = "",
    ic_target  = "",
    ic_troll   = "",
    ic_vote    = "",
}

local IMG = {}
local function loadImg(b64str, name)
    if IMG[name] then return IMG[name] end
    if not b64str or b64str == "" then return nil end
    if b64str:sub(1, 7) == "rbxasset" or b64str:sub(1, 4) == "http" then
        IMG[name] = b64str
        return b64str
    end
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:Base64Decode(b64str) end)
    if not ok or not data then return nil end
    local path = "piddle_" .. name .. ".png"
    pcall(writefile, path, data)
    local ok2, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
    if ok2 and asset then IMG[name] = asset; return asset end
    return nil
end

for k, v in pairs(B64) do
    task.spawn(function() loadImg(v, k) end)
end

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end

local function corner(o, r)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)
    c.Parent = o
end

local function stroke(o, color, trans)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    s.Transparency = trans or 0
    s.Thickness = 1
    s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    s.Parent = o
end

local function tw(o, props, t)
    TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), props):Play()
end

local function getRole(plr)
    if plr == LP then
        if LP.Character then
            if LP.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return "Murderer" end
            if LP.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return "Sheriff" end
        end
        return "Innocent"
    end
    if not plr.Character or plr.Character.Parent ~= workspace then return "NPC" end
    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return "NPC" end
    if plr.UserId <= 0 then return "NPC" end
    return "Innocent"
end

    KillAura=false, KillAuraRange=30,
    KillAll=false,
    AutoGun=false,
    Silent=false, ForceShot=false,
    AutoShot=false,
    Predict=false,
    Speed=false, SpeedVal=50,
    Jump=false, JumpVal=100,
    Fly=false, Noclip=false,
    Spin=false, SpinSpeed=30,
    FakePos=false,
    AutoRespawn=false, AntiVoid=false,
    Aura=false, AuraColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,130),
    ESP_All=false, Tracers=false,
    ESP_Murd=false, ESP_Sher=false, ESP_Inno=false,
}

local flyBV, flyBG = nil, nil
local auraPart, auraLight = nil, nil
local tracers = {}

local killAuraCd = 0

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if State.KillAura and LP.Character and getRole(LP) == "Murderer" then
            safe(function()
                local ch = LP.Character
                local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not (hum and root and hum.Health > 0) then return end
                local best, bd = nil, State.KillAuraRange
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                        local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local th = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if tr and th and th.Health > 0 then
                            local d = (tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                            if d < bd then bd = d; best = p end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if best and tick() - killAuraCd > 0.25 then
                    local tr = best.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if tr then
                        root.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5)
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        local k = ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") or (LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
                        if k then
                            if k.Parent ~= ch then hum:EquipTool(k) end
                            safe(function() k:Activate() end)
                            local ev = k:FindFirstChild("Events")
                            local stab = ev and ev:FindFirstChild("Stab")
                            if stab then safe(function() stab:FireServer() end) end
                        end
                        killAuraCd = tick()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.3)
        if State.KillAll and LP.Character and getRole(LP) == "Murderer" then
            safe(function()
                local ch = LP.Character
                local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not (hum and root) then return end
                local k = ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") or (LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
                if not k then return end
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                        local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local th = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if tr and th and th.Health > 0 then
                            root.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5)
                            if k.Parent ~= ch then hum:EquipTool(k) end
                            safe(function() k:Activate() end)
                            local ev = k:FindFirstChild("Events")
                            local stab = ev and ev:FindFirstChild("Stab")
                            if stab then safe(function() stab:FireServer() end) end
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

local function grabGun(drop)
    if drop and LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local root = LP.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        local part = drop:FindFirstChild("Part") or drop:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if part and firetouchinterest then
            firetouchinterest(root, part, 0)
            firetouchinterest(root, part, 1)
        end
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
    if State.AutoGun and (desc.Name == "GunDrop" or desc.Name == "Gun") then
        task.wait(0.05)
        grabGun(desc)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.05)
        if LP.Character then
            local h = LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h then
                if State.Speed then h.WalkSpeed = State.SpeedVal end
                if State.Jump then
                    h.UseJumpPower = true
                    h.JumpPower = State.JumpVal
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if State.Noclip and LP.Character then
        for _, p in ipairs(LP.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then p.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not State.Fly or not flyBV or not LP.Character then return end
    safe(function()
        local mv = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then mv = mv + Cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then mv = mv - Cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then mv = mv - Cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then mv = mv + Cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
        flyBV.Velocity = mv * 60
        flyBG.CFrame = Cam.CFrame
    end)
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5)
        if State.AutoRespawn and LP.Character then
            local h = LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not h or h.Health <= 0 then
                task.wait(0.5)
                safe(function() LP.Character:BreakJoints() end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if State.AntiVoid and LP.Character then
        local hrp = LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and hrp.Position.Y < -50 then
            local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
            if sp then hrp.CFrame = sp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,5,0) end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if State.Spin and LP.Character then
        local hrp = LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            local a = tick() * State.SpinSpeed
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.CFrame.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(a), 0)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.3)
        if State.Aura and LP.Character then
            local root = LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                if not auraPart or not auraPart.Parent then
                    auraPart = Instance.new("Part")
                    auraPart.Name = "PiddleAura"
                    auraPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    auraPart.Size = Vector3.new(6,6,6)
                    auraPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    auraPart.Color = State.AuraColor
                    auraPart.Transparency = 0.6
                    auraPart.CanCollide = false
                    auraPart.Anchored = false
                    auraPart.Massless = true
                    auraPart.Parent = LP.Character
                    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    w.Part0 = root
                    w.Part1 = auraPart
                    w.Parent = auraPart
                    auraLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
                    auraLight.Color = State.AuraColor
                    auraLight.Range = 12
                    auraLight.Brightness = 3
                    auraLight.Parent = auraPart
                end
                auraPart.Color = State.AuraColor
                if auraLight then auraLight.Color = State.AuraColor end
            end
        else
            if auraPart and auraPart.Parent then auraPart:Destroy() end
            auraPart, auraLight = nil, nil
        end
    end
end)

local function buildESP(p)
    if not p.Character or p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleHL") then return end
    local hd = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not hd then return end
    local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.Name = "PiddleHL"
    h.FillTransparency = 0.5
    h.OutlineTransparency = 0
    h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    h.Enabled = false
    h.Parent = p.Character
    local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    tag.Name = "PiddleTag"
    tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
    tag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    tag.AlwaysOnTop = true
    tag.Adornee = hd
    tag.Enabled = false
    tag.Parent = p.Character
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = 16
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    lbl.Parent = tag
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= LP then
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); safe(buildESP, p) end)
        if p.Character then safe(buildESP, p) end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    if p ~= LP then
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); safe(buildESP, p) end)
    end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if p.Character then
        local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleHL"); if h then h:Destroy() end
        local t = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleTag"); if t then t:Destroy() end
    end
    if tracers[p] then safe(function() tracers[p]:Remove() end); tracers[p] = nil end
    espP[p] = nil
end)

local roleColors = {
    Murderer = Color3.fromRGB(255,60,80),
    Sheriff = Color3.fromRGB(80,140,255),
    Innocent = Color3.fromRGB(80,220,120),
    NPC = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180),
}

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.25)
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                safe(function()
                    if not p.Character then return end
                    local d = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleHL")
                    local t = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleTag")
                    if (not d or not t) and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                        buildESP(p)
                        d = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleHL")
                        t = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PiddleTag")
                    end
                    if not (d and t) then return end
                    local r = getRole(p)
                    local c = roleColors[r] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    local tx = r
                    local show = false
                    if espP[p] then show = true; c = Color3.fromRGB(220,180,255); tx = "SELECTED"
                    elseif State.ESP_All then show = true
                    elseif r == "Murderer" and State.ESP_Murd then show = true
                    elseif r == "Sheriff" and State.ESP_Sher then show = true
                    elseif r == "Innocent" and State.ESP_Inno then show = true end
                    if show then
                        d.Enabled = true
                        t.Enabled = true
                        d.FillColor = c
                        d.OutlineColor = c
                        local lb = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                        if lb then
                            lb.TextColor3 = c
                            lb.Text = tx
                        end
                    else
                        d.Enabled = false
                        t.Enabled = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not State.Tracers then
        for _, line in pairs(tracers) do safe(function() line.Visible = false end) end
        return
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            local hd = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hd then
                local v, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hd.Position)
                if on then
                    if not tracers[p] then
                        local l = Drawing.new("Line")
                        l.Thickness = 1.5
                        l.Transparency = 0.9
                        l.Visible = false
                        tracers[p] = l
                    end
                    local line = tracers[p]
                    line.Color = roleColors[getRole(p)] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    line.To = Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y)
                    line.From = Vector2.new(Cam.ViewportSize.X/2, Cam.ViewportSize.Y)
                    line.Visible = true
                else
                    if tracers[p] then tracers[p].Visible = false end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function createTab(name, label, iconKey)
    local btn = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        LayoutOrder = #tabsHolder:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, tabsHolder)

    local iconBg = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -10),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, btn)

    local icon = new("ImageLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -7, 0.5, -7),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
    }, iconBg)
    task.spawn(function()
        local a = loadImg(B64[iconKey] or "", iconKey)
        if a then icon.Image = a end
    end)

    local txt = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, btn)

    local cont = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Visible = false,
        LayoutOrder = #pageScroll:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, pageScroll)
    new("UIListLayout", {
        Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        Parent = cont,
    })

    tabs[name] = { button = btn, icon = icon, text = txt, container = cont }

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for n, t in pairs(tabs) do
            local on = (n == name)
            t.container.Visible = on
            t.icon.ImageColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130)
            t.text.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130)
            t.button.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            t.button.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1
        end
        pageScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    end)

    return cont
end

local function createGroup(parent, name)
    local g = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, parent)
    corner(g, 6)
    local L = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    L.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    L.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    L.Parent = g
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
    pad.Parent = g
    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = name,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        LayoutOrder = 0,
    }, g)
    return g
end

local function addToggle(parent, label, def, cb)
    local st = def or false
    local r = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, parent)
    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, r)
    local box = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = st and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, r)
    corner(box, 3)
    stroke(box, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), 0)
    local check = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "✓",
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextTransparency = st and 0 or 1,
    }, box)
    local click = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
    }, r)
    if st then safe(function() cb(true) end) end
    click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        st = not st
        tw(box, {BackgroundColor3 = st and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)}, 0.15)
        check.TextTransparency = st and 0 or 1
        safe(function() cb(st) end)
    end)
    return {Set = function(v)
        st = v
        box.BackgroundColor3 = st and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
        check.TextTransparency = st and 0 or 1
        safe(function() cb(st) end)
    end}
end

local function addSlider(parent, label, mn, mx, def, cb)
    local r = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, parent)
    local lbl = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label .. "  ·  " .. def,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, r)
    local bar = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, r)
    corner(bar, 2)
    local fill = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((def - mn) / (mx - mn), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, bar)
    corner(fill, 2)
    local drag = false
    local function upd(input)
        local rel = math.clamp((input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local v = math.floor(mn + (mx - mn) * rel)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Text = label .. "  ·  " .. v
        safe(function() cb(v) end)
    end
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag = true
            upd(i)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            upd(i)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag = false
        end
    end)
end

local function addButton(parent, label, cb)
    local r = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, parent)
    r.MouseEnter:Connect(function() r.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) end)
    r.MouseLeave:Connect(function() r.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220) end)
    r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() safe(cb) end)
    return r
end

local function addColorPicker(parent, label, def, cb)
    local color = def or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local r = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren() + 1,
    }, parent)
    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, r)
    local box = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = color,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, r)
    corner(box, 3)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
    }, r)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(color)
        h = (h + 0.13) % 1
        color = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = color
        safe(function() cb(color) end)
    end)
end

local function clearAll()
    for _, c in ipairs(tabsHolder:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(pageScroll:GetChildren()) do

    end
    tabs = {}
end

    local function applyPack(name)
        local ch = LP.Character
        if not ch then return end
        local animate = ch:FindFirstChild("Animate")

        if not pack then return end
        local function setId(cname, id)
            local c = animate:FindFirstChild(cname)
            if c then
                for _, a in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
                    if a:IsA("Animation") then a.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id end
                end
            end
        end
        setId("idle", pack.Idle); setId("walk", pack.Walk); setId("run", pack.Run)
        setId("jump", pack.Jump); setId("fall", pack.Fall); setId("climb", pack.Climb)
        setId("swim", pack.Swim); setId("swimidle", pack.SwimIdle)
    end

        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character}
        local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(padPos, 25, params)
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            for _, d in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("ImageLabel") and d.Image ~= "" and not d.Image:find("rbxassetid://0") then
                    return d.Image
                end
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(part.Parent:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("ImageLabel") and d.Image ~= "" and not d.Image:find("rbxassetid://0") then
                    return d.Image
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function refreshMapImages()
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local btn = mapButtons[i]
            if btn and btn.img.Image == "" then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local img = findMapImage(MAP_POSITIONS[i])
                    if img then btn.img.Image = img end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, 3 do
        local btn = new("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25),
            Text = "",
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
        }, mapRow)
        corner(btn, 6)
        stroke(btn, Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50), 0)

        local img = new("ImageLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            Image = "",
        }, btn)
        corner(img, 4)

        local nameLbl = new("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            Text = "Map " .. i,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 10,
        }, btn)
        corner(nameLbl, 4)

        mapButtons[i] = { btn = btn, img = img }

        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            voteState.selected = i
            for j = 1, 3 do
                if j == i then
                    mapButtons[j].btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
                else
                    mapButtons[j].btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
                end
            end
            voteStatus.Text = "target: map " .. i
        end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(3)
            refreshMapImages()
        end
    end)
    task.delay(1, refreshMapImages)

    local function voteStandPoint(padPos)
        return padPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    end

    local function votePlant(position)
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function voteKillSelf()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
    end

    local function voteFinish()
        voteState.running = false
        voteState.spot = nil
        if voteState.holdConn then voteState.holdConn:Disconnect(); voteState.holdConn = nil end
        if voteState.spawnConn then voteState.spawnConn:Disconnect(); voteState.spawnConn = nil end
    end

    local function voteBegin(session)
        if not voteState.selected then voteFinish(); return end
        local padEntry = MAP_POSITIONS[voteState.selected]
        if not padEntry then voteFinish(); return end

        voteState.spot = voteStandPoint(padEntry)
        voteState.dupeUsed = 0

        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then voteFinish(); return end

        voteState.origin = hrp.CFrame

        if not votePlant(voteState.spot) then
            voteFinish()
            return
        end

        if not voteState.dupeOn then
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if voteState.session ~= session then return end
                local c2 = LP.Character
                local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if h2 and voteState.origin then
                    h2.CFrame = voteState.origin
                end
                voteFinish()
            end)
            return
        end

        voteState.holdConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if voteState.session ~= session or not voteState.spot then return end
            local c2 = LP.Character
            local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not h2 then return end
            local flat = Vector3.new(h2.Position.X - voteState.spot.X, 0, h2.Position.Z - voteState.spot.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 2.5 then
                h2.CFrame = CFrame.new(voteState.spot)
            end
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            while voteState.dupeOn and voteState.session == session do
                task.wait(1.2)
                if voteState.dupeUsed >= voteState.dupeCap then
                    if voteState.spawnConn then voteState.spawnConn:Disconnect(); voteState.spawnConn = nil end
                    task.defer(function()
                        if voteState.session ~= session then return end
                        local c2 = LP.Character
                        local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if h2 and voteState.origin then
                            h2.CFrame = voteState.origin
                        end
                        voteFinish()
                    end)
                    break
                end
                voteState.dupeUsed = voteState.dupeUsed + 1
                voteKillSelf()
                task.wait(0.8)
            end
        end)

        voteState.spawnConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char2)
            if voteState.session ~= session or not voteState.dupeOn then return end
            local h2 = char2:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 6)
            if not h2 or voteState.session ~= session or not voteState.spot then return end
            if voteState.dupeUsed >= voteState.dupeCap then
                if voteState.origin then
                    h2.CFrame = voteState.origin
                end
                return
            end
            h2.CFrame = CFrame.new(voteState.spot)
        end)
    end

    addToggle(sI1, "duper", false, function(v)
        voteState.dupeOn = v
        if v then
            voteState.running = true
            voteState.session = voteState.session + 1
            voteBegin(voteState.session)
            voteStatus.Text = "running..."
        else
            voteFinish()
            voteStatus.Text = "stopped"
        end
    end)

    addButton(sI1, "stop duper", function()
        voteState.dupeOn = false
        voteFinish()
        voteStatus.Text = "stopped"
    end)

    local first = next(tabs)
    if first then
        tabs[first].container.Visible = true
        tabs[first].icon.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
        tabs[first].text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
        tabs[first].button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
        tabs[first].button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    end
end

buildAllTabs()

-- ПЕРЕТАСКИВАНИЕ UI
local dragHolder = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 60),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "",
    AutoButtonColor = false,
    Active = true,
    ZIndex = 100,
}, main)

local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
local currentInput

dragHolder.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = main.Position
        currentInput = input
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local openBtn = new("ImageButton", {
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.5, -26),
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 9999,
}, gui)
corner(openBtn, 26)
stroke(openBtn, Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50), 0)

task.spawn(function()
    local a = loadImg(B64.logo, "logo")
    if a then openBtn.Image = a end
end)

local btnDrag, btnStart, btnMoved = false, nil, false
local btnStartPos

openBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        btnDrag = true
        btnStart = input.Position
        btnStartPos = openBtn.Position
        btnMoved = false
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if btnDrag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = input.Position - btnStart
        if d.Magnitude > 8 then
            btnMoved = true
            openBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, btnStartPos.X.Offset + d.X, 0, btnStartPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if btnDrag and not btnMoved then
            gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
        end
        btnDrag = false
    end
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.H then
        gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
    end
end)
